This blog accompanies the [Collyer Lab of Evolutionary Morphometrics and statistics](https://www.michaelcollyer.com/), providing an environment to post clever or helpful examples of analysis, graphical display, or computational comparisons, using `R` packages designed in the Collyer Lab.  These posts are not really the typical themes found in a lab website, but visitors might find them useful, enjoyable, creative, or annoying, just not obfuscating the normal presentation of lab website information.
